name: Комната Пушка
prompt: A peaceful, tidy bedroom belonging to Puff, a soft lavender bean-shaped creature. Lavender, light lilac, cream and muted blue-gray colors. A neatly made bed, bedside table, organized bookshelf, small tea table with one cup, board games, wall clock, wardrobe and organized storage boxes. Everything is clean, symmetrical and carefully arranged. Hand-drawn children's storybook illustration on warm textured paper. Preserve the exact room layout and furniture.
